passage: The painter Jacob Lawrence completed his Migration Series, sixty panels depicting the movement of African Americans from the rural South to northern ______ when he was just twenty-three years old.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: “sixty panels depicting…cities” is an appositive opened by a comma after “Migration Series.”
It must close with a matching comma.
A semicolon or colon would cut the sentence wrongly, and no comma leaves the appositive unclosed.
key: Nonessential phrases opened with a comma must close with a comma.
